decisions.decision: No article on the Stretch Code will be placed on the upcoming Town Meeting; the consensus of the other six members is that too many questions remain open. The majority agree with scheduling an article before the Fall Town Meeting.
decisions.quote: the majority of members agree with the schedule of placing an article before the fall town meeting

decisions.decision: Criteria review conclusions recorded: #1 by-right zoning in place; #2 expedited permitting in place; #3 20% savings over 5 years unattainable without grant monies; #4 fuel-efficient vehicle purchase attainable; #5 stretch code possible but effect unclear.
decisions.quote: #2 - expedited permitting process is in place

decisions.decision: The Selectmen will be asked to direct Department Heads to gather the record data needed for the energy use software.
decisions.quote: the selectmen will be asked to direct department heads to gather the information required.

decisions.decision: P. Slattery and M. Benson will draft a question to DOER, submitted through Kelly Brown; the question format will go to members for input and approval before release.

decisions.decision: Future meeting will be held either 3/24 or 3/29 to meet with M. Sauvegeau.
decisions.quote: future meeting schedule will be either 3/24 or 3/29 to meet with of m. sauvegeau.
